Name: Dog waste complaints.
Title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to dog waste complaints
BodyName: Committee on Sanitation and Solid Waste Management

History.Description: This Introduction was Introduced by Council
This Introduction was Referred to Comm by Council to the Committee on Sanitation and Solid Waste Management
This Introduction was Hearing Held by Committee
History.BodyName: Committee on Sanitation and Solid Waste Management

History.Description: This Introduction was Laid Over by Committee
History.BodyName: Committee on Sanitation and Solid Waste Management

Summary: This bill would require DSNY, upon receiving 7 or more credible complaints of dog waste on the same city block within a 7-day period, to dispatch employees within 14 days to evaluate the block and enforce, as appropriate, state and local prohibitions against animal waste in public spaces.
Text:
Be it enacted by the Council as follows:


Section 1. Chapter 1 of title 16 of the administrative code of the city of New York is amended by adding a new section 16-146 to read as follows:
§ 16-146 Dog waste complaints. No later than 14 days after the department receives 7 or more credible complaints of dog waste on the same city block within a 7-day period, the commissioner shall dispatch employees of the department to evaluate the conditions on such block and enforce section 161.03 of the health code and section 1310 of the public health law as appropriate.
§ 2. This local law takes effect immediately.
